description: This file contains a unit test class for the UserRoleManagerService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various aspects of retrieving and instantiating the user role manager class, including handling of configuration, class existence, inheritance validation, and boundary conditions like missing logged-in users.

classes.name: InvalidUserRoleManager
classes.description: A dummy class used for testing invalid subclass scenario.

classes.name: UnitTestUserRoleManager
classes.description: A mock subclass of AbstractUserRoleManager used for unit testing the UserRoleManagerService.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of user role manager class name from configuration.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerExistingClass
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the user role manager with a valid class name obtained from configuration.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerInvalidClass
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when the configured class is not a subclass of AbstractUserRoleManager.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNonExistingClass
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when the configured class does not exist.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNoLoggedInUser
methods.description: Checks behavior when there is no logged-in user, expecting a ServiceException.
